批次参数已锁定。要调整参数，请新建批次。: Batch settings are locked. Start a new batch to change them.
选择照片目录，或打开已有批次: Choose photos or open an existing batch
导出为 Excel 可打开的 CSV: Export a CSV that opens in Excel
打开照片与裁剪预览: Open the photo and crop preview
可下拉选页，或输入页码后按 Enter: Select a page or type its number and press Enter
滚轮缩放 · 中键平移 · 拖动角点: Scroll to zoom · Middle-drag to pan · Drag corners to adjust
拖入照片，或在左侧选择照片与结果目录。: Drop photos here, or choose photos and a result folder on the left.
可更改状态或文件名筛选。: Try changing the status filter or search.
请输入 1–{0} 的页码。: Enter a page number from 1 to {0}.
可拖入一个文件夹，或一组 JPG、PNG、BMP、TIFF、WebP 照片。: Drop one folder or a group of JPEG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, or WebP photos.
当前四角尚未保存。放弃这次调整？: The current corners haven't been saved. Discard these changes?
选择新批次的照片与结果目录。: Choose photos and a result folder for the new batch.
打开包含 batch_session.json 的结果目录: Open the result folder that contains batch_session.json
请先选择原照片和结果目录。: Choose the source photos and a result folder first.
没有未处理照片。可筛选待复核或开始新批次。: No pending photos. Review the current batch or start a new one.
正在完成当前照片并保存进度，随后暂停。: Finishing the current photo and saving progress before pausing.
请先勾选已经检查过的照片。: Select the photos you have checked.
成功 {0} · 跳过 {1} · 失败或待恢复 {2}: Saved {0} · Skipped {1} · Failed or pending recovery {2}
「{0}」的内容与上次保存时不同。是否用这次的裁剪结果覆盖？: “{0}” differs from the last saved file. Replace it with this crop?
四边内切需填写 0 到 100 之间的整数。: Enter an integer from 0 to 100 for the edge inset.
已核对照片内容并重新定位批次。: Verified photo contents and relocated the batch.
抽查 {0} 张自动通过照片，优先显示接近通过门槛的结果。: Auditing {0} auto-accepted photos, starting with borderline results.
四边证据满足自动通过规则，可继续检查角点。: The four sides meet the automatic checks. Review the corners if needed.
检查完整图片边界，确认后保存。: Check the full image boundary before saving.
无法打开原照片: Could not open the source photo
已重新定位，可检查角点后保存。: Detected a new frame. Check the corners before saving.
点击照片选择新位置，其他角点会保留。: Click the photo to place the selected corner.
复核结束，拍摄失败表需要更新。: Review finished. Update the capture failure CSV.
已归档 {0} · {1}。可更新拍摄失败表。: Archived {0} · {1}. You can update the failure CSV.
完成当前照片并保存进度后关闭。: Finishing the current photo and saving progress before closing.
扩展搜索（贴边、近拍、大角度）: Extended search (near edges, close-ups, tilted views)
{name} 是文件名，{ext} 是原扩展名。输出扩展名自动添加。: {name} is the filename and {ext} is the source extension. The output extension is added automatically.
导出图会应用 EXIF 方向，并移除 EXIF 与 ICC 等元数据。像素按常规: Exports apply EXIF orientation and omit EXIF and ICC metadata. The app decodes in standard RGB without ICC conversion. Originals retain their metadata.
请检查输出尺寸、质量和命名模板。: Check the output size, quality, and naming template.
请选择存在的 JPG、PNG、BMP、TIFF 或 WebP 照片。: Select existing JPEG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, or WebP photos.
同一批次的照片必须位于同一磁盘。: Photos in a batch must be on the same drive.
结果目录应与原照片目录分开，且不得包含原照片目录。: Choose a separate result folder that does not contain the source folder.
输出尺寸、格式或质量设置无效。: The output size, format, or quality is invalid.
原照片不能位于结果目录中。: Keep source photos outside the result folder.
当前命名或目录设置会产生同名结果。请保留子目录或在模板中加入 {ext}。: The naming and folder settings produce duplicate outputs. Preserve subfolders or add {ext} to the template.
这个目录已有批次，请打开已有批次或选择新目录。: This folder already has a batch. Open it or choose a new folder.
所选目录缺少 batch_session.json。: The selected folder is missing batch_session.json.
结果目录已移动。请使用「重新定位批次」。: The result folder has moved. Use Relocate batch.
请选择与结果目录分开的原照片目录。: Select a source folder separate from the result folder.
原照片找不到，请重新定位原照片目录。: The source photo is missing. Relocate the source folder.
已导出的照片找不到，可以安全重试。: The exported photo is missing. You can retry safely.
导出文件已修改，请在复核时选择是否覆盖。: The export changed. Review the file and decide whether to replace it.
原照片内容已改变。请恢复原文件或将新照片导入新批次。: The source photo changed. Restore the original or import the new photo into a new batch.
照片在预览期间发生变化，请重新打开这张照片。: The photo changed during preview. Reopen it.
请关闭占用这个文件的程序后重试。: Close the program using this file and try again.
请检查原照片，或重新定位批次。: Check the source photo or relocate the batch.
请检查照片能否打开，必要时转换为支持的格式。: Check that the photo opens or convert it to a supported format.
请释放结果磁盘空间后重试。: Free space on the result drive and try again.
可在单图复核中检查结果并确认覆盖。: Review the individual photo before confirming replacement.
请先恢复待保存的结果，再导出备份。: Recover pending outputs before exporting a backup.
命名模板无效。可用 {name} 和 {ext}，无需填写输出扩展名。: Invalid naming template. Use {name} and {ext}; the extension is added automatically.
该批次正在另一个窗口写入，请等待它结束后刷新。: Another window is writing to this batch. Wait for it to finish, then refresh.
该批次已在另一个窗口更新。请先刷新批次，再继续操作。: Another window updated this batch. Refresh it before continuing.
没有找到四边完整的目标边界: No complete outer boundary was found
边界与背景对比不足: Low contrast between border and background
边框外侧存在明显纹理干扰: Texture outside the frame interferes with detection
目标形状偏离正方形，需检查完整性: The target departs from a square. Check the full frame
缺少细边框证据，可能选中了图片内部内容: Weak thin-frame evidence. The frame may cut into the image
扩展检测结果，请核对完整边界: Extended detection result. Check the full boundary
扩展搜索找到更大的不同边界，请比较候选框: Extended search found a larger frame. Compare the proposals
边界四角几何无效: The four corners do not form a valid frame
批次日志不完整，无法安全恢复。请使用批次备份。: The batch journal is incomplete. Restore a batch backup.
记录中的路径超出批次目录。: A recorded path is outside the batch folder.
图片无法解码，或像素位深不受支持。: The photo could not be decoded or its bit depth is unsupported.
请选择原图范围内的四个角点。: Select four corners within the source photo.
四角必须构成有效凸四边形。: The four corners must form a valid convex quadrilateral.
内切像素过大。: The edge inset is too large.
结果内容不匹配：: Output does not match its record:
旧裁剪文件已修改，请先保留或移走旧文件：: The prior crop changed. Keep or move it first:
待恢复的输出文件缺失或损坏：: Output awaiting recovery is missing or corrupt:
旧裁剪文件已修改，请保留或移走旧文件：: The prior crop changed. Keep or move it first:
表格待重试。请关闭占用文件的程序后点「更新批次报表」。: Report update pending. Close the program using the file and choose Update batch reports.
无法备份内容已变化的文件：: Cannot back up a changed file:
